definitions.accounting: the same sum over zero target days (zero), over positive days with e < 0 (positive_over) and over positive days with e >= 0 (positive_under), each divided by the full 9 h; the three parts sum to QScore9
definitions.context_scaled_qscore9: QScore9 / max(1, the context mean saved in the row)
definitions.crps_availability: counted from the saved reasons; no law requires no_count_distribution and no value, a certified value requires no reason and a residual bound below 1e-8, otherwise the reason is crps_bound_not_certified with no value; CRPS values are not recomputed

new_variant_structure.hurdle_dynamic: P(Y > 0) equals dynamic_count's on every target day; the positive law is the saved completed law conditioned on Y >= 1, or delta_1 exactly where that law has P(Y > 0) = 0
new_variant_structure.occurrence_model_size_count: P(Y > 0) equals the saved completed law's on every target day; the positive law is hurdle_count_28's

definitions.occurrence_brier: mean over target days of (P(Y > 0) - 1[y > 0])^2, P(Y > 0) from each saved count law's registered definition; only where a law is saved for every target day
definitions.qscore9: 2 / (9 h) times the sum over the h target days and tau = 0.1, ..., 0.9 of max(tau e, (tau - 1) e), e = y - q_tau
